cuda: use the implicit GEMM conv2d path for F32 kernels ( #32482 ) The fast CONV_2D path (implicit GEMM with MMA, or cuBLAS for pointwise convolutions) required an F16 kernel. F32 kernels fell back to the naive direct convolution, which is much slower than im2col + mul_mat on large channel counts. Convert F32 kernels to F16 in a pool buffer, as is already done for the input, and take the same path with F32 accumulation. The Metal implicit GEMM kernel already stages both operands as F16.
